data.title: Steel Advance Event Pass: March 24 – April 13
data.meta_title: Steel Advance Event Pass: March 24 – April 13
data.content:
On Tortuga, every meter of ground is taken and retaken. Frontlines shift by the second, and survival belongs to the machines that can endure punishment and keep moving.

Pilots need war machines built to hold the line — and to advance when the moment finally arrives.

Hitcher answers that call.

Steel Advance Event Pass

Running from March 24 to April 13, the Steel Advance Event Pass brings the Hitcher War Robot, Nucleon weapons, tactical gear, and a wide selection of cosmetics. 

Progress through Shipments to assemble Hitcher module by module, unlock powerful weapons and survival gear, and earn valuable resources alongside distinctive Wraps, Decals, and unit insignias drawn from the Predator Squadron.

Event Pass Price: 325 Warp Reals

New Shipments of rewards become available as you progress through the Event Pass. Complete it before April 13 to claim everything it has to offer.

Shipment 1

There is no requirement to unlock this Shipment.

  • Hitcher Chassis
  • x2 Nucleon Weapons
  • Emergency Shield (Supply Gear)
  • Enchanted Warlord Paint
  • Space Invader Paint
  • 175 Intel
  • 3,000 Credits
  • 30,000 Salvage

Shipment 2

Spend 10 Battle Tokens to unlock this Shipment.

  • Hitcher Chassis
  • x2 Nucleon Weapons
  • Hitcher Torso
  • Viper Unit Sticker
  • Buzzard Unit Sticker
  • High Voltage Sticker
  • 150 Intel
  • 3,000 Credits
  • 50,000 Salvage

Shipment 3

Spend 20 Battle Tokens to unlock this Shipment.

  • Hitcher Shoulder
  • Nucleon Weapon
  • Nanite Repair (Cycle Gear)
  • Iron Veil (Cycle Gear)
  • Bull Unit Sticker
  • Martian Pioneer Paint
  • Freshborn Alloy Paint
  • Digital Devil Decal
  • Caution Sticker
  • 100 Intel

As the battle for Tortuga intensifies, only the toughest machines can claim ground and hold it.

Deploy Hitcher, power up your Nucleon arsenal, and lead the advance.
